parent_package: C36 regularized same-subgroup n-Miller gauge collapse
positive_result: The state is public, O(log n), generator-sensitive, and selects one square-root branch over an explicit public radicand.
negative_result: No ordinary quadratic decoder, no single maximal 2-primary decoder, and no seven-C34-location multiplicative monomial decoder survives the frozen corpus.
rational_boundary: On every frozen curve, any one-variable rational decoder A(S)/B(S) has max degree at least (n-1)/2.
claim_boundary: No arbitrary nonlinear decoder lower bound, parity oracle, sub-root evaluator, or sub-square-root ECDLP algorithm is claimed.
